title: A-SAW: The Agentic Software Architecture Workflow
abstract: arXiv:2610.13647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI assistance in software engineering focuses on implementation and verification, leaving the design phase, and in particular the maintenance of architecture documentation, comparatively underserved. Architecture as Code makes architectural artifacts versionable, diffable, and machine-readable, but it does not reduce the effort of keeping them updated, so design documentation still ends up as a fragmented, author-dependent, and only partially trusted record of why a system looks the way it does.   In this paper we introduce the Agentic Software Architecture Workflow (A-SAW), a process-level artifact that extends Architecture as Code with a persistent agent layer: an IDE-integrated agent drafts architecture documents from a version-controlled C4 model, a typed element catalog, and instrumented templates. translated_title: A-SAW：智能体软件架构工作流
translated_abstract: AI在软件工程中的辅助目前主要集中在实现与验证环节，而设计阶段，尤其是架构文档的维护，则相对缺乏支持。“架构即代码”使架构制品能够版本化、可对比差异且可被机器读取，但它并未降低保持这些制品持续更新的工作量，因此设计文档最终仍然是碎片化的、依赖作者个人经验的、且只有部分可信的关于“系统为何呈现当前形态”的记录。本文提出了智能体软件架构工作流（A-SAW），这是一个流程级制品，通过引入一个持久化的智能体层来扩展“架构即代码”：一个集成于IDE中的智能体基于版本化管理的C4模型、类型化的元素目录以及插桩模板起草架构文档。每份草稿在被采纳之前都必须通过强制性的人工审查关口。我们在一个大型工业组织中沿两条路线对其进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出A-SAW工作流，通过持久化的智能体层让IDE集成智能体基于C4模型等来源自动起草架构文档，并辅以强制人工审查关口，从而降低架构文档维护成本并提升其可信度。
en_tdlr: A-SAW extends Architecture as Code with a persistent agent layer in which an IDE-integrated agent drafts architecture documents from a version-controlled C4 model, coupled with a mandatory human review gate, reducing the burden of keeping architecture documentation up to date.
